meta.title: PSDA Taxonomy Re-Derivation: Two-Pass Reconciliation
meta.method: Pass 1 (write derivation) + Pass 2 (blind audit) from official CB question bank, 373 questions across 21 PDFs
meta.status: PROPOSAL — for Karl + owner reconciliation. NOT written to canonical file.

skills.skill_name: Ratios, Rates, Proportional Relationships, and Units

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Unit conversion (linear units)
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes independently split single-step vs multi-step conversion. P1: 17+11, P2: 11+13. High-confidence split.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Ratios and proportional scaling
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes identify a proportion-setup-and-solve sub-skill. P1: 14q, P2: 15q. Substantial overlap in evidence IDs.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Rates between different quantities
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes identify single-step rate application. P1: 15q, P2: 11q. Core: given rate * quantity = total.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Density and per-area/per-volume rates
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes keep density as distinct. P1: 13q, P2: 7q. P1 lumped more multi-step density problems in; P2 separated them to RAT.9.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Converting squared or cubed units
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes keep this as distinct. P1: 4q, P2: 4q. Same 4 evidence IDs in both. High confidence.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Single-Step Unit Conversion
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 17q, P2: 11q. Difference in count due to P2 being stricter (excluding rate-application questions that P1 included).

proposed_sub_skills.name: Multi-Step (Chained) Unit Conversion
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 11q, P2: 13q. Core: two or more conversion factors applied in sequence.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Squared and Cubed Unit Conversion
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree on exactly the same 4 questions. P1: 4q, P2: 4q.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Single-Step Rate Application
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 15q ('Direct Rate Application'), P2: 11q ('Rate Application'). Core: rate * quantity or total / rate.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Proportion Setup and Solve
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 14q ('Setting Up and Solving Proportions'), P2: 15q. Core: a/b = c/d, solve by cross-multiplication.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Density and Derived-Rate Calculations
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 13q, P2: 7q. Difference: P1 included multi-step density problems P2 placed in RAT.9.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Multi-Step Rate and Proportion Problems
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P1: 10q ('Proportional and Rate Reasoning with Algebra'). P2: 9q ('Multi-Step Rate and Proportion Problems'). Both identify a 'hard composite' tier. P2 also carved out RAT.6 (Proportional Expression Construction, 8q) and RAT.7 (Ratio Interpretation, 6q) as separate sub-skills — FLAGGED for Karl's decision.
proposed_sub_skills.karl_decision_needed: P2 carved two additional sub-skills (Proportional Expression Construction: 8q, Ratio Interpretation: 6q). Should these be separate sub-skills or clusters within RAT.5/RAT.7?

off_spec_patterns.description: Exponential rate (doubling); P1 flagged as off-spec for RAT, may belong to a growth/decay skill
Rate + constant offset (not purely proportional); P1 flagged

proposed_clusters.name: Direct Factor Application
proposed_clusters.description: Single multiplication/division by a given conversion factor or rate.

proposed_clusters.name: Cross-Multiplication
proposed_clusters.description: Setting up a/b = c/d and solving the linear equation.

proposed_clusters.name: Conversion-Factor Chaining
proposed_clusters.description: Two or more sequential conversion multiplications, including squared/cubed.

proposed_clusters.name: Density Formula Application
proposed_clusters.description: density = total / area-or-volume, rearranged as needed.

proposed_clusters.name: Ratio-to-Expression Translation
proposed_clusters.description: Translating a stated ratio into an algebraic expression with a variable. P2 only.

proposed_clusters.name: Multi-Operation Rate-Proportion Composition
proposed_clusters.description: Primary rate/proportion step plus additional arithmetic (percentage, subtraction, scale factor).

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Percent of a quantity
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1 kept as one (18q). P2 split into Find-Part (8q), Find-Percent (4q), Find-Whole (4q). P2's split is pedagogically sound — different operations. But Find-Percent and Find-Whole are thin (4q each). RECOMMEND: split Find-Part from Find-Percent/Find-Whole but keep the latter two combined.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Unknown percent or unknown whole
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Current PCT.2 maps to P2's PCT.2+PCT.3. Under proposed reconciliation, this becomes part of the Find-Percent/Find-Whole sub-skill.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Apply or undo a single percent increase or decrease
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P2 split into: Apply forward (PCT.4, 5q), Reverse/undo (PCT.6, 3q). P1 kept combined (19q). RECOMMEND: keep combined — the reverse case (3q) is too thin standalone.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Percent change between two values
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree this is distinct. P1: 6q, P2: 6q. Stable.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Chained percents (percent of a percent result)
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P2 split into: Successive Percent Changes (9q), Chained Percent Relationships (7q), Compound Category Percentages (4q). P1 kept as one (19q). RECOMMEND: split Successive Changes from Chained Relationships — these are genuinely different cognitive operations.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Find the Part (Percent of a Quantity)
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P1: included in 18q 'Percent of a quantity'. P2: 8q 'Find the Part'. Both agree this core operation exists.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Find the Percent or Find the Whole
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2 split these; P1 kept combined. Combined: ~8q. These are the inverse operations of PCT.1. Keeping combined avoids 4q sub-skills.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Apply or Undo a Percent Increase/Decrease
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree this is distinct from basic percent-of. P1: 19q, P2: 5q forward + 3q reverse = 8q. P2 also carved out Percent-as-Expression (11q) and Interpret-Expression (3q) — see PCT.4.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Percent as Algebraic Expression (Construct or Interpret)
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2 only: PCT.7 (11q, construct) + PCT.8 (3q, interpret) = 14q. P1 folded these into PCT.1/PCT.3. The 14q count and Medium-Hard concentration make this a viable NEW sub-skill.
proposed_sub_skills.karl_decision_needed: P2 identified 14 questions where the answer is a symbolic expression, not a number. P1 distributed these across PCT.1 and PCT.3. Should this be a separate sub-skill?

proposed_sub_skills.name: Percent Change Calculation
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 6q, P2: 6q. Core: ((new-old)/old)*100.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Successive Percent Changes
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree this is distinct within the 'chained' category. P1: part of 19q 'Chained percents'. P2: 9q 'Successive Percent Changes'. Core: chain multipliers (1+r1)(1-r2).

proposed_sub_skills.name: Chained Percent Relationships (Transitive)
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2: 7q, all Hard. P1: part of 'Chained percents'. Core: 'a is X% of b, a is Y% of c, find b as % of c'. Genuinely different operation from successive changes.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Percent from Data (Table/Chart Reading + Percent Computation)
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2 only: 9q. P1 distributed these across PCT.1-PCT.3. Core: read data THEN compute a percent. The data-reading step is prerequisite.
proposed_sub_skills.karl_decision_needed: P2 carved out 9 questions where a data-reading step precedes percent computation. P1 classified these by the type of percent operation instead. Is 'data then percent' a separate sub-skill or a cluster?

off_spec_patterns.description: Exponential percent growth/decay (P2: PCT.13, 2q). These involve a^t exponential expressions — may belong more to Algebra than PSDA.

proposed_clusters.name: Proportion Setup and Solve
proposed_clusters.description: part/whole = rate/100, solve for the unknown.

proposed_clusters.name: Percent-Change Formula Application
proposed_clusters.description: ((new-old)/old)*100.

proposed_clusters.name: Single-Multiplier Construction or Interpretation
proposed_clusters.description: Convert verbal percent to (1+r/100) or (1-r/100) and apply or read.

proposed_clusters.name: Multiplier Chaining
proposed_clusters.description: Compose two or more multipliers sequentially.

proposed_clusters.name: Reverse Division (Undo a Percent)
proposed_clusters.description: Divide result by multiplier to recover original.

proposed_clusters.name: Transitive Substitution Across Percent Links
proposed_clusters.description: a=(p/100)*b, substitute to find c as % of d.

proposed_clusters.name: Data Extraction Then Percent Computation
proposed_clusters.description: Read from table/chart, then compute percent.

proposed_clusters.name: Nested Subset Computation
proposed_clusters.description: Apply percent to subtotal, not original total.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Probability of an event in the whole group
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1 merged PRB.4 into PRB.1 (25q). P2 split by data source (description: 11q, frequency table: 4q, 2-way marginal: 6q, 2-way joint: 2q). RECOMMEND: keep merged — P2's splits are by data format not cognitive operation.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Conditional probability (restricted sample space)
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 10q, P2: 10q. Same evidence IDs. High confidence.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Find a count from a probability or from totals
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 6q, P2: 5q. Stable.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Complement and exclusion events
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1 explicitly merged PRB.4 into PRB.1. P2 distributed complement questions into PRB.7 (2q). With only 2-6 questions, complement is a cluster within whole-group probability, not a standalone sub-skill.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Whole-Group Probability
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P1: 25q (absorbed PRB.4). P2: 11+4+6+2 = 23q (split by data source). Both agree on the boundary — whole group vs restricted sample. Merge PRB.4 complement/exclusion in as a cluster.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Conditional Probability
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree exactly. P1: 10q, P2: 10q. Core: restricted sample space ('given that', 'of those').

proposed_sub_skills.name: Find a Count from Probability
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 6q, P2: 5q. Core: given P and total, find count; or given P and count, find total.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Complement and Multi-Event Probability
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Current PRB.4 has 6 evidence IDs. P1 merged into PRB.1. P2 carved PRB.7 (2q) + PRB.8 (2q). Very thin. RECOMMEND: demote to cluster within PRB.1.
proposed_sub_skills.karl_decision_needed: Both passes suggest complement/exclusion is too thin for a standalone sub-skill (2-6q). Should it be a cluster within PRB.1, or remain a separate sub-skill?

off_spec_patterns.description: Both passes flag this question. P1: 'CB mis-tag, table arithmetic not probability'. P2: classified under PRB.6. The question may not be a true probability question.

proposed_clusters.name: Direct Ratio (favorable/total)
proposed_clusters.description: Read counts, divide favorable by total.

proposed_clusters.name: Complement Arithmetic
proposed_clusters.description: P(not A) = 1 - P(A), or sum of non-target categories.

proposed_clusters.name: Restricted Sample Space
proposed_clusters.description: Identify the conditional subset, then compute within it.

proposed_clusters.name: Algebraic Count-Finding
proposed_clusters.description: Set up P = x/N or P = k/x and solve.

proposed_clusters.name: Two-Way Table Navigation
proposed_clusters.description: Locate the correct cell/margin in a two-way table before computing.

skills.skill_name: One-Variable Data: Distributions and Measures of Center and Spread

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Read and interpret a data display
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree strongly. P1: 10q, P2: 17q (P2 found more questions from the 73-page PDF). High confidence.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Find a measure of center from data
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1 kept combined (21q). P2 split: Compute Mean (9q), Find Median (11q). The operations are genuinely different (sum/divide vs order/locate). RECOMMEND: split.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Measures of spread: range and SD
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1: 6q combined. P2: Compute Range (3q) + Compare SDs (4q). Range is max-min; SD comparison is visual distribution reasoning. Different operations. But Range alone is thin (3q). RECOMMEND: keep combined as 'Measures of Spread'.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Use the mean-total relationship
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1: 7q. P2: Solve for Unknown Using Mean (7q) + Combined/Weighted Mean (2q). Weighted mean is a distinct operation. But 2q is very thin. RECOMMEND: keep combined.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Compare measures across data sets or after a change
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: P1: 12q. P2: Compare/Relate Measures (13q) + Effect of Data Changes (7q). P2's split is pedagogically sound — comparing is conceptual; effect-of-change requires algebraic reasoning. RECOMMEND: split.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Read or Interpret a Data Display
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 10q, P2: 17q.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Compute the Mean
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2: 9q. P1 included mean questions in a combined 'Measures of Center' (21q). Splitting mean from median is pedagogically justified — different algorithms.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Find the Median
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2: 11q. P1 included in combined 'Measures of Center'. Median uses order-and-locate, fundamentally different from mean's sum-and-divide.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Measures of Spread (Range and SD Comparison)
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree spread is distinct. P1: 6q, P2: Range 3q + SD comparison 4q = 7q. Keep combined to avoid thin sub-skills.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Use the Mean-Total Relationship (Algebraic)
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 7q, P2: Solve-for-unknown 7q + Combined mean 2q = 9q.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Compare or Relate Measures of Center and Spread
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2: 13q. P1: part of 12q 'Compare measures'. Core: reason about mean vs median, compare across groups, identify statistics by properties.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Effect of Data Changes on Statistics
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: P2: 7q (Medium+Hard). P1 folded into 'Compare measures'. Core: add/remove/modify values, determine effect on mean/median/range/SD. Genuinely distinct operation.
proposed_sub_skills.karl_decision_needed: P2 carved 7 questions about how data modifications affect statistics. P1 included these in the broader 'compare' sub-skill. Should this be separate?

proposed_clusters.name: Graph/Table Value Extraction
proposed_clusters.description: Visual-to-numeric translation from displays.

proposed_clusters.name: Sum-and-Divide (Mean Computation)
proposed_clusters.description: Add values, divide by count.

proposed_clusters.name: Order-and-Locate (Median Finding)
proposed_clusters.description: Sort and find middle position.

proposed_clusters.name: Max-Minus-Min (Range)
proposed_clusters.description: Identify extremes, subtract.

proposed_clusters.name: Algebraic Mean Inversion
proposed_clusters.description: sum/count = mean, solve for unknown.

proposed_clusters.name: Distribution-Shape Reasoning
proposed_clusters.description: Use shape (skew, concentration) to infer statistical relationships.

proposed_clusters.name: Data-Modification Effect Analysis
proposed_clusters.description: Reason about how a change propagates to statistics.

proposed_clusters.name: Statistic Identification and Selection
proposed_clusters.description: Match a property description to the correct statistic.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Read data and changes from a graph
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree: reading raw values (P1: 8q, P2: 16q) is different from computing average rate of change (P1: 6q, P2: 6q). Current TVD.1 mixes both.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Predict with a fitted model and compare data to it
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree: prediction from LOBF (P1: 9q, P2: part of TVD.1) is different from residual computation (P1: 4q, P2: 4q). Current TVD.2 mixes both.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Linear model: direction, slope, intercept, equation, interpretation
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree on splitting: estimate slope (6q), write equation (12-13q), interpret slope in context (3q). Current TVD.3 lumps all linear model work.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Nonlinear model fitted to a scatterplot
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 4q, P2: 3q. Small but distinct.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Classify linear vs exponential relationships
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 11q, P2: 12q. Expanded to include quadratic classification. Rename to 'Classify Model Type and Describe Associations'.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Read Values from Graphs and Models
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 8q (raw data only), P2: 16q (includes LOBF reading). Count difference: P2 combined raw + LOBF reading; P1 separated them. RECOMMEND: include both raw and LOBF value reading.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Estimate the Slope of a Line of Best Fit
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree exactly. P1: 6q, P2: 6q. Same evidence IDs.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Choose or Write a Line of Best Fit Equation
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 12q, P2: 13q. Core: select y=mx+b from choices or construct it.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Classify Model Type and Describe Associations
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 11q, P2: 12q. Core: linear vs exponential vs quadratic; positive/negative association.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Compute and Use Residuals
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 4q ('Evaluate Residuals'), P2: 4q. Core: observed minus predicted.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Average Rate of Change
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 6q, P2: 6q. Core: (y2-y1)/(x2-x1) across intervals.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Interpret Slope or Intercept in Context
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 3q ('Interpret Slope/Intercept'), P2: 3q. All Hard. Core: translate slope to real-world meaning.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Choose a Nonlinear Model Equation
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 4q, P2: 3q. Core: select quadratic or exponential equation for curved data.

proposed_clusters.name: Visual Data Extraction
proposed_clusters.description: Read a value from a plotted point or model line.

proposed_clusters.name: Slope Computation from Two Points
proposed_clusters.description: Pick two points, compute rise/run.

proposed_clusters.name: Sign-and-Intercept Reasoning
proposed_clusters.description: Determine equation by reasoning about slope sign and y-intercept.

proposed_clusters.name: Pattern Classification
proposed_clusters.description: Examine how values change to classify as linear/exponential/quadratic.

proposed_clusters.name: Residual and Deviation Analysis
proposed_clusters.description: Compute observed minus predicted, or count above/below.

proposed_clusters.name: Interval Rate-of-Change Computation
proposed_clusters.description: Compute and compare (y2-y1)/(x2-x1) across intervals.

proposed_clusters.name: Contextual Slope Interpretation
proposed_clusters.description: Translate numeric slope into real-world meaning.

proposed_clusters.name: Nonlinear Model Fitting by Key Features
proposed_clusters.description: Match curve to equation via vertex, intercept, direction, base.

skills.skill_name: Inference from Sample Statistics and Margin of Error

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Estimate a population count from a sample
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree: population estimation is distinct. P1: 10q, P2: core of INFS-B (7q) + INFS-C (1q) + INFS-H (1q) = 9q.

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: Interpret an estimate with a margin of error
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes agree: MOE interpretation is distinct. P1: 14q, P2: core of INFS-A (10q) + INFS-D (2q) + INFS-E (1q) + INFS-F (1q) = 14q.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Interpret Margin of Error
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree this is the dominant sub-skill. P1: 14q, P2: 14q (spread across INFS-A/D/E/F). Core: estimate +/- MOE interval construction and interpretation.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Estimate Population Values from Samples
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 10q, P2: 9-10q (INFS-B/C/H). Core: sample proportion * population size.

skills.pass2_fine_splits_rejected: P2 proposed 8 sub-skills, but 5 of them had only 1 question each (INFS-C, INFS-E, INFS-F, INFS-G, INFS-H). These are too thin to stand alone. They are better represented as clusters within the two main sub-skills. INFS-G (Generalization scope, 1q) may actually belong in ESC.

proposed_clusters.name: Construct Confidence Interval from Estimate and MOE
proposed_clusters.description: Apply estimate +/- MOE.

proposed_clusters.name: Evaluate Claims Against MOE Interval
proposed_clusters.description: Determine if a value falls within or outside the interval.

proposed_clusters.name: Factors Affecting MOE Size
proposed_clusters.description: Smaller sample = larger MOE.

proposed_clusters.name: Compute Sample Statistic from Raw Data
proposed_clusters.description: Calculate proportion or mean from sample before scaling.

proposed_clusters.name: Scale Sample Proportion to Population Count
proposed_clusters.description: Multiply sample proportion by population size.

proposed_clusters.name: Multi-Step Estimation
proposed_clusters.description: Complement proportion, then scale; or combine MOE with scaling.

skills.skill_name: Evaluating Statistical Claims: Observational Studies and Experiments

current_to_proposed_mapping.current_name: No current sub-skills exist for ESC
current_to_proposed_mapping.rationale: Both passes independently derived exactly 3 sub-skills with the same question assignments (different naming only). Highest confidence in the entire PSDA reconciliation.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Determining Generalization Scope
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree on name, definition, and evidence. P1: 6q (82dfb646, b4f5a7ca, 6fca0144, 7ce2830a, 7d68096f, 1ea09200). P2: 6q (same IDs). Perfect match.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Identifying Sampling Bias
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 3q (9bf4c545, 4a422e3e, aa43b41f). P2: 3q (same IDs). Perfect match.

proposed_sub_skills.name: Understanding Sample Variability
proposed_sub_skills.rationale: Both passes agree. P1: 2q (37930b2a, 642519d7). P2: 2q (same IDs). Perfect match. Thin (2q) but conceptually distinct.

proposed_clusters.name: Sampling Frame Identification
proposed_clusters.description: Identify the population from which the sample was drawn to determine generalization boundary.

proposed_clusters.name: Sampling Method Critique
proposed_clusters.description: Recognize non-random or biased sampling methods.

proposed_clusters.name: Estimate vs Exact Value Distinction
proposed_clusters.description: Understand that sample statistics are estimates, not exact population values.
